verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer runs client-facing platforms (GDHQ, Contract Generator, Catalyze) and uses AI internally (ChatGD), so asking whether client data can be kept out of AI training is a fair privacy question for this product. However, the evidence only says ChatGD runs on a 'secure, enterprise instance of OpenAI's models through Microsoft Azure.' It never states that client data is excluded from model training, and it describes no opt-out or user-facing control.
